  WHERE e.activity IN ('Fim da viagem', 'Declaração rejeitada pelo funcionário', 'Pagamento efetuado')
),

JOIN event_log e2
  ON e1.idcase = e2.idcase
 AND e1.activity = e2.activity
 AND e2.timestamp = (
   SELECT MIN(e3.timestamp)
   FROM event_log e3
   WHERE e3.idcase = e1.idcase
     AND e3.timestamp > e1.timestamp
 )
WHERE e1.timestamp < e2.timestamp
ORDER BY e1.idcase
